name: yokoten
description: Rules, guards and skills for AI coding agents: the tool-call guard, doctor at the start of each session, and the yokoten skills and agents.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'yokoten: the guard cannot run, because node is not on PATH for this agent; run yokoten doctor in a terminal' >&2; exit 1; }; { err=$( ( node --max-old-space-size=256 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.mjs" hook --commands-only --agent claude-code 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-; c=$?; printf x; exit $c ) 2>/dev/null ); code=$?; } 3>&1; case $code in 0|2) printf %s "${err%x}" >&2;; *) echo "yokoten's guard failed (exit $code), so the command is refused; run \`yokoten doctor\`" >&2; code=2;; esac; exit $code
